newsitem.title: UK: India awards 580,000 t diesel for March - trade.
newsitem.headline: India awards 580,000 t diesel for March - trade.

text.p: The Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded 14 cargoes of high speed diesel totalling 580,000 tonnes for March delivery, in line with expectations, traders said on Friday.
The awards are mostly for 1.0 percent sulphur, with the remainder for 0.25 percent sulphur, they said.
IOC last month bought 810,000 tonnes of 1.0 percent sulphur and 45,000 tonnes of the 0.25 percent grade in two tenders for February deliveries.

The traders said Shell had won four cargoes, all for 1.0 percent cent material. Two, of 45,000 tonnes, were for Madras or Haldia on the east coast. A third, of 45,000 tonnes, was for Kandla on the west coast, and a fourth, of 30,000 tonnes, would go into Goa/Kandla on the west coast.
